lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters (spots) extending from the branchial region to the caudal peduncle. The spots are most clearly defined and larger in the central lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a distinct grid-like lattice where white spots act as nodal points at the intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance upper edges and lower-luminance shadowed regions immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 high-luminance spots, primarily concentrated in the anterior and medial sections of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, high-frequency cluster of micro-spots is visible on the cranial region, transitioning to the larger, more structured grid pattern posterior to the gill slits.
